title: Property transactions — Falcon Corp.
instructions: Falcon Corp., a calendar-year C corporation, had the 2025 property transactions below. It has no prior §1231 losses.

exhibits.title: Sales
exhibits.content:
| Asset | Cost | Depreciation | Sale price |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Equipment (held 5 years) | 300,000 | 180,000 | 200,000 |
| Warehouse (straight-line; held 12 years) | 1,000,000 | 200,000 | 1,150,000 |
| Land used in the business (held 8 years) | 250,000 | — | 200,000 |

exhibits.title: Exchange and acquisition
exhibits.content:
- Falcon exchanged investment land (basis **$400,000**; FMV **$700,000**) for land worth **$650,000** plus **$50,000** cash.
- Falcon placed a new office building in service on **March 10, 2025** (cost **$3,900,000**, excluding land). It elects no §179 or bonus on the building.

rows.label: Recognized gain on the land exchange
2025 depreciation on the office building (compute with the mid-month formula, not the IRS tables; round to the nearest dollar)
rows.explanation: 3,900,000 ÷ 39 = 100,000 × 9.5 ÷ 12 = **79,167** (mid-month; March). The IRS table percentage (2.033%) gives 79,287 because the table rounds the rate.

rows.label: The net §1231 gain for Falcon is treated as
rows.explanation: No lookback losses; corporations pay 21% on it.
